name: Messenger AI
tagline: An AI agent added to group chats that reads texts, PDFs and images to answer, summarise and make memes.
problem: Group study chats lack an assistant that sees the whole conversation.
solution: An agent joins iMessage group conversations as a contact and uses their content as context.
demo_moment: Team-described: ask the group's AI for a summary of the PDF someone shared.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Exploring Hybrid Intelligence by Photon” among 195 submissions.
Solved adding an agent as a group-chat participant.

lessons: Agents in group chats are a natural home for shared context.
